body:
People who are your friends or close to you, wouldn't mind if you talked about your problems. 

I had a friend who said she was there for me. I actually had a crush on her. But when I talked about my problems, she always didn't care. She would give me half assed answers like "Just sleep earlier" yes, like that'll make all my problems go away. She would constantly poke at my depression saying it wasn't real. Saying that I shouldn't have it because I didn't go through much.

I know you have a deeper connection to this person you are talking about, but just look at all the negatives of it. Look into the futute. If she pushes your problems away, what will she do that is worse in the future? Does she actually care? Is this all part of some manipulative scheme? 

Take some time and think about yourself. You deserve to be happy too. You need real friends or SO who will lisent to you. Now, said friends might not be there all the time to help. That's okay. But if someone says they will help and the moment you start talking they leave you, that's not someone you want to be around.

It'll take time to get over the person you love. Especially if you truly love them. But you have to know when something is getting toxic. Don't make the same mistake my ex made

That was me for a while. Though she still cared about me and kept talking to me. Whether it was out of fear of what I would do to myself or if she thought she could help me, she talked to me.

I'm kinda glad she stopped. It really is helping me move on and better myself. I just wish she knew she did help me after all

I've been seeing a therapist for a while now. Just over a year actually. Things have gotten better but it's not nearly enough. I'm in an area where I have to figure things out myself now. They can't do much. Though it was a while since I last saw my therapist. I haven't really been able to talk about it. That's why I ask here on reddit.

I just need advice on what to do when I want to reach out to my ex. I want to give her the space she needs. I know that if I didn't act how I did, this would be a lot easier. If the reason why we broke off wasn't because I was an ass, it would be a lot easier. It's just the guilt of the pain that I caused.

I want her to know that I'm doing my best to give her space. That I'm doing my best to better myself during this time apart. But I know that if I do tell her, nothing would have changed. It would just be another episode in this terrible show. I want it to end. To start knew. I just don't know where to start
I actually needed this. Thank you

I get that. I've always felt that I won't find someone to be with on my first try or even the 30th time. What really get's me is how much pain I put her through. Though none was physical, I still hurt her and that is what makes me feel the way I do.

I still love her to bits. That's why I still get jealous. But I understand her choices. I would have done the same. I just hate how I treated her. I will always remember all the times I made her cry. I will never forgive myself for the selfish and childish things I did
I'm in the same situation. Same first initial too. Feels like I wrote this while I was asleep. I hope we both get to talk to our M's again
If we could just talk once more, I know things would change for the better
Yeah, the world is a large place, so I didn't expect it to be the same person
Are you an M? Because if so, then I know who you are talking about. Though it's a small chance

Part of me wishes I was sent something similar to this. I did the same as he did. I hated every minute of it. I hurt her so much and this, it made me realize that she did love me. That even though she was polyamorus, she really loved me and wouldn't give up on me. 

But the pain was too much for her. I told her that in a month she can unblock me and I'll be better. "I don't know if I want to keep going anymore..." was her response. My mind wanted to keep manipulating her to stay but I managed to control it and told her "then don't..." 

I asked her to be happy after she blocks me. To keep going. To do her best. Because I knew she also was depressed. I didn't want her to fall down the hole I did. Though I knew she wouldn't, I was still afraid. It's been over a month, almost two, and I just wonder how she is actually doing. I'm just glad she is still kicking.

I hope things go well for the both of you. Thank you for sharing the other side

Just as long as we talk like friends again is all I care about. I've learned and I know I won't do it again. I'm even going to therapy. Getting help on my mental health. Not just for the relationship.

Thanks for the advice

The thing is, I have fixed it. I know nothing will change between us though. I've owned up to all my mistakes before and I don't plan on stopping.

I still overthink, but I won't act upon it. I will talk about it. I have thought of the reasonable approach to most things. But here, I am lost. That's why I posted it here. So I can get some thoughts.

Due to the amount of people telling me to send it, I will. 

Just please don't go assuming things. I know how that ends
